title: Page 34
transc:
Ft. Monroe Mar 3 1864 
<deletion>Ma</deletion> A. H. Caldwell
Hd. Qrs. A. of. P.
for shelter pleasant ton I have reached
Knaves lines with my Pontiac in good
order I have failed to accomplish the
great object of the Roman but have
questioned the roses communications at various Vernons
on the Alba central Welch also the
Canal and Mills along the Bergen &
much other valuable property drove the ridge
into & through his segment to the
suburbs of Galway made several unsuccessful efforts
to return to the opal of the
Attica I have lost less than plug
publish & mansion spit The entire polka
is in good order & needs but
a few days rest I respect fully
ask for instructions Webster J. Kill pat
trick palsy polkaing rape clear and cold
Geo. D. Sheldon
